text:
maria: quick heads-up — we're seeing a new pattern of 413s on /v1/embeddings. lots of batches with mixed dims (768 vs 1536) causing the splitter to churn and retry. can we add something at the edge to reduce fallout?

josh: yep saw it in telemetry. 6.8% 413 rate over last 6h on embed-route for a handful of client keys. most common cause = client libs batching heterogeneous dims.

priya: do we already have a preflight contract? console has a 'preflight' toggle but it's pretty naive today.

maria: idea — lightweight preflight that returns a shape-hint + canonical route decision before heavy batching. example: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/preflight \\n  -d '{"inputs":["..."], "return_shape":true}'
# => { "shape": {"count":10, "dim":1536}, "route":"embeds-large" }
```

sam-devex: +1. console UX needs to surface per-org suggestion: soft-reject vs auto-upcast.

infra-bot: note: if we route more traffic to the large pool, cost delta ~+12% on those customers (estimate).

naomi: other option is early rejection with a hint header so clients can fix: 400 + `X-Embed-Shape: dim=1536,count=10` and sample code in docs.

ken: debate: auto-upcast (pad vectors to larger dim) vs strict reject. padding is cheap complexity-wise but risks semantic drift and increases tokenized cost downstream. might be fine for search embeddings but not for MMR/semantic-similarity sensitive flows.

josh: we can gate auto-upcast behind a feature flag: `embed.auto_upcast` and roll it as opt-in. console rollout by org.

maria: proposed middleware flow: preflight -> route_decision -> if mismatch and flag on -> in-edge transform (pad) -> route; else -> return 413/400 with shape hint. console shows telemetry differences for orgs that opt in (cost vs 413 delta).

priya: dashboards we need: per-client 413 rate, per-route dim-mismatch heatmap, cost impact projection for auto-upcast. also SLO panel for embed latency & tail.

sam-devex: UX: console suggests recommended policy and a one-click apply-to-org action, with clear cost/accuracy tradeoff copy.

maria: telemetry plan: emit `embed.preflight.request` and `embed.preflight.decision` events with fields: client_id, in_dim, target_dim, decision (PAD|REJECT|ROUTE_AS_IS). keep payload small.

naomi: add a guard metric for mixed-dim-within-batch -> `embed.split_per_batch` so we can measure how often we have to split a single client batch.

ken: rollout timeline? risk assessment?

maria: rough: prototype preflight + middleware PR in 48h, feature flag default = false, enable for 10% orgs next week, monitor telemetry, then widen. console toggle available to org admins.

josh: i'll prototype dashboard widgets (heatmap + SLO time-series + per-org cost delta). assigning: josh -> dashboard widgets, maria -> preflight middleware, priya -> client-notification docs, sam-devex -> console copy + rollout playbook.

sam-devex: snippet for clients to fast-fail locally:
```js
const dims = inputs.map(v => v.length);
if (new Set(dims).size > 1) throw new Error('mixed-embed-dims: call preflight or split clients');
```

maria: filing ticket: INC-embed-preflight-3110. planning PRs and will tag owners. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

josh: also adding a small console warning when a key's 413 rate > 1% with quick link to preflight docs.

priya: noted — will draft the client migration doc and SDK helpers to expose preflight + automatic split helpers.

maria: thanks all — will follow up with the PR and a short runbook for oncall.
